scope: Complete illustrative media collection for the nine-page website and fifteen funding programmes
tablet_policy: Tablet files are labelled selections from desktop or mobile compositions, with origin recorded per asset. They are not independent new photographs.

images.title: Hospital hero
images.alt: Architectural visual of Antharagange hospital, showing its facade and entrance.
images.usage: Use the transparent desktop image at the right of the hero, with copy in the curved negative space. Mobile uses the full-bleed 4:3 version above the heading. Keep the original aspect ratio on cutouts; do not crop their alpha boundary.

tablet.note: Reuse of the most suitable existing composition, not a third independently generated scene.

images.title: Rural-first care
images.alt: Illustrative image of a rural family speaking with a clinician.
images.usage: Use inside the expandable Rural-first photo panel. On mobile, use the portrait image for the selected panel. Place the caption in HTML with an optional CSS overlay.

tablet.note: Reuse of the most suitable existing composition, not a third independently generated scene.

images.title: Disability-first rehabilitation
images.alt: Illustrative image of a physiotherapist encouraging a boy who uses a wheelchair.
images.usage: Use as the central expanded mission image. Keep both faces and the wheelchair visible. The portrait mobile image is composed for an approximately 4:5 container.

tablet.note: Reuse of the most suitable existing composition, not a third independently generated scene.

images.title: Eye-care screening
images.section: Purpose mosaic / Community-first AND Our Work / Eye care
images.alt: Illustrative image of a clinician performing an eye screening with an older man.
images.usage: Reuse this same asset for the Community-first mosaic panel and the Meenakshi programme slide. Wide desktop and 4:3 mobile files are provided. Do not describe it as a photograph from an actual hospital camp.

tablet.note: Reuse of the most suitable existing composition, not a third independently generated scene.

images.title: Rural health camp
images.section: Our Work / Rural health camps slide
images.alt: Illustrative image of blood-pressure screening at a rural community health camp.
images.usage: Second programme slide. Keep the nurse, cuff and patient in the crop. Use the wider contextual image on desktop and the 4:3 mobile composition on small screens.

tablet.note: Reuse of the most suitable existing composition, not a third independently generated scene.

images.title: PraChi first-aid training
images.alt: Illustrative image of an adult first-aid workshop using a CPR training manikin.
images.usage: Third programme slide. This is educational imagery of a manikin, not an actual emergency or recorded PraChi event. Keep the instructor hands and the training torso visible.

tablet.note: Reuse of the most suitable existing composition, not a third independently generated scene.

images.title: Clinician and patient cutout
images.alt: Illustrative image of a doctor listening to an older patient.
images.usage: Desktop cutout sits on the right of a navy section, allowing care-path content on the left. The mobile portrait cutout is optional: place after the heading or below the vertical pathway; it can be omitted to match the leaner reference mobile layout. Preserve intrinsic ratio and alpha.

tablet.note: Reuse of the most suitable existing composition, not a third independently generated scene.

images.title: Community landscape vignette
images.alt: Illustrative rural Karnataka landscape with rocky hills, greenery and village buildings.
images.usage: Desktop has transparent left and upper edges for a white text-led section. Mobile has a transparent upper edge and should sit below the partnership links. Representative regional imagery, not a verified view from the campus or a branch map.

tablet.note: Reuse of the most suitable existing composition, not a third independently generated scene.

pages.title: Home
pages.device_note: Desktop split hero and photo mosaic; mobile full-bleed hero and selected portrait panels.

pages.title: Our Hospital
pages.device_note: Desktop panoramic purpose imagery and loop explorer; mobile stacked portrait and vertical selectors.

pages.title: Care & Services
pages.device_note: Desktop service explorer; mobile selected service image and touch-friendly accordion. Use images as content, not clinical instructions.

pages.title: Our Work
pages.device_note: Desktop filmstrip; mobile 4:3 programme slides. The first-aid file is a poster/still, not a real programme video.

pages.title: Locations & Outreach
pages.device_note: Illustrative network only. Campus addresses, maps and branch photographs must come from verified hospital sources.

pages.title: Health-Card Initiative
pages.device_note: Physical-card art keeps its intrinsic aspect ratio on all devices; stage layout and registration photograph reflow.

pages.title: CSR & Institutional Partnerships
pages.device_note: Use the need explorer and document rows, never a retail product grid. Covers are artwork for the supplied DOCX proposals.

pages.title: Individual Programme Brief
pages.device_note: Use the programme mapping for all fifteen briefs. Desktop wide room imagery; mobile 4:3 room views or portrait people scenes.

pages.title: Contact & Collaborate
pages.device_note: Desktop split enquiry context; mobile stacked imagery and form. Keep fields and confirmations as HTML.
